Not run with a credentialed model: there the same crash is expected whenever the workflow settles after the turn, since session_shutdown aborts it (src/index.ts:1254) and the same unguarded callback then runs. pi --version = 1.2.0; the pin's own pi 1.1.0 carries the same assertActive (node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/extensions/loader.js:112,194-257). Cause: src/index.ts:3617-3629 `void runWorkflowTask(ctx, task).then(() => { pi.appendEntry(…); pi.sendMessage(…) })` has no catch, while the tool path's scheduleNudge wraps its send in try/catch (src/index.ts:597-603); pi print mode disposes right after the prompt loop (dist/modes/print-mode.js:103-138). Promise: README.md:525 'Composes with headless mode: `pi -p --subagents-workflow-file=review.js`', docs/workflows.md:319 'including headless under `pi -p`'. cost: Every operator, CI job or wrapper script that uses the documented flag headlessly on pi >= 1.1: 100% of runs where print mode ends before the workflow settles (always with no prompt; with a prompt whenever the workflow outlives the single turn). They get exit 1, a 26 KB stack dump and no result.
